text:
tom: Quick heads-up from customer onboarding: our sampleapp-prefetch showed duplicated pages under a short burst when using the Python SDK. Node/Go didn't show it.

lara: Repro steps I used: spawn 50 parallel clients hitting /list with prefetch=2, permits=20 against staging token. After a few 401s we observed page tokens processed twice and the client returned duplicate items.

lara: Snip of local log (trimmed):
```
DEBUG paginator: fetched page=3 token=abc123 inflight=5
WARN auth: token refresh threw, scheduling retry
DEBUG paginator: fetched page=3 token=abc123 inflight=6
DEBUG paginator: fetched page=3 token=abc123 inflight=6  # duplicate fetch
```

mohit: Is the inflight accounting in the paginator (higher-level) or the request executor (lower-level)? If two layers both track permits we can double-count on retry.

lara: It's in client/prefetch/semaphore.py (python). My quick trace: on AuthError the retry path requeues the page fetch but doesn't release the semaphore permit before requeueing. Node has a contextmanager that always releases permits.

qa-bot: CI history: https://ci.redwood/flake/4912 shows intermittent test_paginator_double_fetch on linux-py. Suspected timing with token refresh.

mohit: Concrete fix idea: make permit acquire/release a contextmanager used around the entire fetch+retry lifecycle, or ensure release is in finally block before requeue. Also consider moving token refresh to a dedicated auth queue so the paginator isn't responsible for retries.

lara: Minimal safe patch I validated locally (pseudo):
```py
with inflight.permit():
    try:
        resp = fetch_page()
    except AuthError:
        refresh_token_sync()
        # rethrow so higher-level scheduler can requeue
        raise
```
This makes sure we don't leak permits when the auth handler steals control.

tom: Can you open a PR that includes: unit test that simulates concurrent auth failure + requeue, an integration test on staging that runs the sampleapp under load, and an instrumentation metric `inflight_permit_leak_total` with a small alert?

lara: Yup. I'll add a small README troubleshooting blurb too: "If you see duplicate items during onboarding, check SDK version and inflight permit drain. Workaround: upgrade to 0.8.4 or set permits>32 while we backport."

mohit: Backport plan: patch 0.8.2 and 0.8.3 branches, since a few customers pin older SDKs. Also add a note in our breaking-changes doc describing parity differences across SDKs.

dev-bot: please include failing log snippet and CI flake link in PR so QA can pin the e2e.

lara: Will do. Opening PR in ~45m and tagging @mohit and @qa-bot. Thanks! :+1:
